lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Hello again! It is me, Barnaby. I love to look at the <color=red>sky</color>.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: I have three <color=red>riddles</color> about space. Get them right, and three new books go to the library!

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Last night I went for a walk. I looked up at the <color=red>stars</color>.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Riddle 1: I shine at night. Sometimes I am round. Sometimes I am thin. What am I?
lines.hint: Not quite. What do you see shining in the sky at night?

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Riddle 2: I am very hot and very bright. I make the day. What am I?
lines.hint: Not quite. What is hot and bright up in the sky?
lines.correctText: Well done! It is the sun.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Riddle 3: I am tall and fast. I zoom up into <color=red>space</color>. What am I?
lines.hint: Not quite. What can fly all the way up into space?
lines.correctText: That is right! It is a rocket.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: You got all three! Three new <color=red>books</color> are going to the library.

afterLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
afterLines.text: Look up at night. Can you see the <color=red>moon</color>?
